headline: Japan Proposes Regional Oil Stockpiling Task Force at ASEAN Summit
summary: Japan proposed establishing a dedicated task force during the ASEAN summit to coordinate regional cooperation on strategic oil reserves and energy security across Asia.
why: ASEAN member states rely heavily on imported Middle Eastern oil, prompting initiatives to enhance collective strategic petroleum reserves.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Joint regional oil stockpiling coordination improves Asian energy security against supply shocks.
